about: Abilities: what a creature can choose to do. Orsino skills and spells are generated into data/catalog/orsino/abilities.json; this file holds Kyr's own abilities and adaptations. kind is technique, spell (with tradition, level and school or domain; a spell spends one slot) or natural. effect is written in the Kyr effect language; effects is the typed form.

source.notes: Orsino offers player-side combatants Flee every turn: an even chance (Math.random() < 0.5; Kyr rolls from the seeded stream) to end the fight. Orsino's monster Escape skill rolls a will save that, as written for fear effects, makes a successful save fail; Kyr uses the player rule for every creature that flees.

fire_ward.name: Fire ward
fire_ward.description: Ward a companion against fire for about two hours.

source.notes: Kyr technique granted by a ward focus; applies fireproof on the world clock for twelve units.

rending_bite.name: Rending bite
rending_bite.effect: Deal (1d6) physical damage to enemy. Apply bleeding to enemy for 2 turns unless constitution save against (11).

rime_bite.name: Rime bite
rime_bite.effect: Deal (2d6) cold damage to enemy. Apply weakened to enemy for 3 turns unless constitution save against (11).

winter_howl.name: Winter howl
winter_howl.effect: Apply stun to enemies for 1 turn unless wisdom save against (12).

custodian_sweep.name: Bronze sweep
custodian_sweep.effect: Deal (1d6) physical damage to enemies unless dexterity save against (11).
custodian_sweep.windup: raises its bronze arms for a great sweep

custodian_chain.name: Burial chain
custodian_chain.effect: Deal (1d6) physical damage to enemy. Apply weakened to enemy for 3 turns unless strength save against (12).

breathe_fire.name: Fire breath
breathe_fire.description: Fire pours over everyone before the creature. A quick or hardy creature takes half. The fire takes a while to rekindle.

source.notes: Area fire damage scales as 2d6 + 2 per creature level, with a breath save for half and a three-turn recharge. Maturity supplies a generated dragon level; its natural bite remains available.

breathe_cold.name: Cold breath
breathe_cold.description: Breath strikes every enemy; a breath save halves damage. Recharges in three turns.

breathe_acid.name: Acid breath
breathe_acid.description: Breath strikes every enemy; a breath save halves damage. Recharges in three turns.

breathe_lightning.name: Lightning breath
breathe_lightning.description: Breath strikes every enemy; a breath save halves damage. Recharges in three turns.

breathe_poison.name: Poison breath
breathe_poison.description: Breath strikes every enemy; a breath save halves damage. Recharges in three turns.

conjure_light.name: Light
conjure_light.description: A small steady light that hangs over a companion's shoulder for two hours.
conjure_light.effect: Apply lit to ally for 2 hours.

source.notes: The old-school Light spell, which Orsino's catalog lacks; every mage learns it as an apprentice.

knock.name: Knock
knock.description: For an hour, locks and bars open at the caster's touch.
knock.effect: Apply unbarring to ally for 1 hour.

source.notes: The old-school Knock, which Orsino's catalog lacks: whoever bears it may do what lockwork does for an hour.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: Stand in front of a companion: until your next turn, blows aimed at them strike you.
guard.effect: Apply guarded to ally for 2 turns.

source.notes: A warrior's interception, in place of positions or reach.

maul.name: Maul
maul.description: Make a powerful attack that deals 1d6 + strength modifier extra damage and inflicts bleeding on a successful hit.
maul.windup: rears up on its hind legs

source.notes: Orsino's Maul without its slow (which Kyr cannot execute), given to bears as a blow they gather for a turn first: stun the bear in between and it is lost.
